headline: Argentine Government Withdraws Bill to Levy Income Tax on Cedears
summary: The executive branch sent a note to the Chamber of Deputies canceling the initiative to apply income tax to Cedears, arguing the text was based on an old version.
why: Tax policy proposals on foreign depository receipts directly influence investment sentiment and retail trading activity in local capital markets.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Withdrawing the proposed tax removes a potential tax burden on foreign share certificates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Canceling the proposed tax on Cedears removed an anticipated friction cost for local investors holding foreign equities via depository receipts.
